findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Building full payloads before filtering or aggregating moves more bytes and allocates more intermediate state than needed.
findings.likely_impact: Higher memory use, longer serialization time, and avoidable network or logging overhead.
findings.recommended_remediation: Filter earlier, narrow the fields being built, or batch serialization closer to the sink.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Constructing only the bytes that are actually needed reduces memory traffic and output overhead.

findings.title: Repeated setup or parsing inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 340 recreates parsers, formatters, mappers, regexes, or other setup-heavy objects.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Rebuilding invariant helpers during each iteration spends CPU cycles and allocations on work that can usually be reused.
findings.likely_impact: Higher latency, avoidable GC churn, and lower throughput on larger collections.
findings.recommended_remediation: Hoist reusable helpers outside the loop and cache invariant computations.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Reusing expensive helpers reduces instructions executed and memory churn per item processed.

findings.title: String concatenation in loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 227 builds strings through repeated concatenation.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated concatenation can allocate many intermediate strings in hot iteration paths.
findings.likely_impact: Extra allocation churn and slower formatting-heavy paths.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use a shared `StringBuilder` or defer formatting until it is needed.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Reducing intermediate strings lowers heap churn and CPU spent copying characters.
